question: Why can the teaching be ineffective for those lacking capacity?
premises: Liquor affects people differently by capacity
What is declared may not work for everyone
Great capacity determines receptivity to teaching
inference: The teaching, like liquor, is not effective for those without the requisite capacity.
uncertainties: The exact referent of mahāntasya is contextually open
plain_english: Just as liquor is said to have no effect on a great one, so this teaching may not be effective for some.
